summary.intent: Complete v1.1 milestone gap-closure phases 42 (API unpin integrity), 43 (FUSE write durability), and 44 (IPNS conflict handling) via the GSD manager — discuss, plan, and execute all three phases end-to-end with automated wave-based parallel worktree execution.
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully implemented and verified: Phase 42 landed guardedUnpin with advisory locks, outbox/drain worker, audit metrics, Grafana alerts, and quota reconcile; Phase 43 landed a persist-backed WriteQueue journal across Linux FUSE, macOS FUSE, and WinFsp with crash-recovery replay; Phase 44 landed three-way mergeChildren, ConflictError retry loop, and a full caller sweep across sdk-core, sdk, and web. Phase 44 execution finished with unresolved TypeScript errors in sdk and web packages at the end of the transcript.

repo: Kubo v0.40 runs with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) — 'server' profile disables local-network discovery but keeps full public DHT participation, meaning every pinned CID is broadcast as a provider record and is CID-discoverable by crawlers.

The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) was JWT-only with no ownership check — any account holder could unpin another user's content by supplying a harvested CID; no live cross-user legitimate unpin path existed.
BYO-IPFS provider.unpin path was broken in both directions before Phase 42; guardedUnpin fixes server-side silently ('not pinned' swallowed), and BYO advisory rows count against refcount equally.
writable-share saves drop prunedCids without issuing an unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — not a legitimate cross-user unpin path.

pnpm test double-dash breaks jest: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` causes pnpm to insert '--' making jest treat the flag as a positional regex pattern. Must use: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`
WinFsp cross-compilation fails on macOS (pre-existing: windows-future and winfsp-sys registry crates); `cargo check` catches project-code errors without triggering the cross-compile failure.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` on all git Bash calls; failures require restarting the 1Password desktop app.
gsd commit helper returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log`, never retry blindly.

cleanup-wave must be run from the repo root, not from inside a worktree; running from a worktree causes false `base_mismatch` errors. Also not idempotent — already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on re-run, requiring a reduced manifest with only remaining entries.

nest build has a side-effect of reformatting openapi.json in the main working tree (564+ line formatting-only diff); must `git checkout --` restore it before merging worktrees to avoid spurious merge conflicts.
Decision coverage gate uses mechanical grep requiring a literal `D-07:` citation in plan must_haves — vague prose references don't satisfy it.
.prettierignore did not exist, causing prettier pre-commit hooks to mangle .planning/ markdown and break VALIDATION.md table syntax (pipe characters interpreted as table columns).

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID that content-addressed dedup may share with another user — now rerouted through guardedUnpin (Plan 42-05).
updateFileMetadata call site — rewired in Phase 44 from old ipnsRecord/batchPublishIpnsRecords pattern to new CAS contract returning { ipnsName, metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids }.
prunedCids dropped here without issuing unpin — confirmed not a legitimate cross-user unpin source; also rewired in Phase 44 to consume Plan-03 file CAS return shape.
handle_release ordering after Phase 43: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943) — enforces journal-fsync-before-ack (D-04, D-05).

Windows write path had a journal.remove() call inside the background upload thread that was removed during Phase 43 gap closure (CR-08) — removal inside spawn creates an orphan window; replay-on-mount is the authoritative cleanup path.
Kubo service configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 tcp+udp publicly exposed — confirms DHT provider records for all pinned CIDs are broadcast to the public IPFS network.

workflow: GSD manager loop on Claude Code: discuss runs inline via Skill(), plan and execute always run inline (not backgrounded) because backgrounded agents cannot nest the plan-checker or worktree-isolated executor subagents.

Wave-based worktree execution: each plan executes in an isolated git worktree off a captured base SHA; manifests track worktree→branch mappings; cleanup-wave merges them back sequentially; worktrees must have node_modules and .husky cruft removed before cleanup or it aborts.
Post-merge gate should target only phase-touched crates/packages with explicit jest patterns — never run full monorepo test suites in orchestrator context due to RAM constraints.

When a planner/executor agent errors mid-run (socket close), check disk for partially-written files before re-spawning; files already on disk are complete and a continuation agent for remaining items is cheaper than a full re-run.
Verification loop: verifier outputs VERIFICATION.md with gaps_found status → planner generates gap closure plans → executor runs them → re-verify; the loop continues until status is passed.

Per-phase git branches (feat/<phase-name>) are managed by GSD; rebasing downstream feature branches onto completed upstream branches after phase close keeps the history linear and ensures CONTEXT.md is visible.

Human-verify checkpoints in plans (e.g., DB migration confirmation) can be auto-approved under --auto if an independent programmatic check (e.g., to_regclass() query) passes — the orchestrator runs the check and records the evidence.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures required restarting the desktop app mid-session; all git commits need dangerouslyDisableSandbox:true which adds latency and permission prompts.
gsd commit helper false negatives ('committed: false' on successful commits) caused confusion and unnecessary retries throughout all three phases.
Planner agent hit a socket error after writing plans 01-03 of Phase 42, requiring a filesystem-check fallback and a continuation agent for plans 04-08.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent and requires running from repo root — both properties caused repeated failures requiring manual manifest surgery and cwd correction.
openapi.json formatting drift (from nest build) in the main tree caused a spurious merge conflict that had to be detected and reverted before each wave-3 merge.
Worktree cruft (node_modules symlinks, .husky/_) blocked cleanup-wave; later executor prompts needed explicit CLEANUP instructions to preempt this.
42-05 merge left a dangling MERGE_HEAD that required manual `git commit --no-edit` to conclude.
Decision coverage gate D-07 failed due to mechanical grep requiring literal citation format — required manual must_haves patch in 42-03-PLAN.md.
Two accidental user inputs ('touring wyatt web bossy') interrupted execution mid-wave; session quota limits hit twice requiring conversation continuations.
.prettierignore was missing entirely, causing prettier to mangle planning-directory markdown files (regex pipes converted to table columns in VALIDATION.md).
TypeScript errors in sdk and web packages appeared after wave-3 merge of Phase 44 and were not resolved before the transcript ended.
Phase 43 gap closure required 8 plans (4 original + 4 gap closure) instead of 4, adding a full extra planning+execution cycle after initial verification.
open_items: TypeScript errors in sdk and web packages from Phase 44 wave-3 post-merge typecheck were unresolved at transcript end — needs investigation and fix.

Phase 43 UAT file (43-UAT.md) contains 4 runtime items requiring manual verification (FUSE crash-recovery replay behavior, WriteParked tray notification, WinFsp journal ordering on real Windows hardware, MkdirConflict retry).
Security gate flagged for Phase 42: SECURITY.md is missing — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` should be run.
BYO provider.unpin client wiring deferred — server-side guardedUnpin fixes the no-row case silently, but BYO clients don't call provider.unpin on delete flows.
Pending-uploads UI deferred — surfaced during Phase 43 discuss; full pending uploads UI with queue visualization noted as future improvement.
Writable-share prunedCids leak deferred — shared-write.ts drops prunedCids without unpinning; acceptable now but creates quota drift over time.
Rust FUSE merge parity deferred — Phase 44 three-way merge is TypeScript only (D-09 confirmed); Rust crates/fuse read_ops conflict handling not in scope.

Read-only drift report (detect-only Kubo pin ls diff vs pinned_cids ∪ pending_unpins) planned in Phase 42 design for historical orphan detection — implemented as PendingUnpinProcessor.runDriftReport but operational use/alerting not wired up.

Phase 42 source todos for cross-user unpin and quota decrement bugs were manually moved to completed; auto-close skipped because they lacked resolves_phase tags — tagging convention should be applied to future todos.
